1.1.0.title: Compute v1.1.0
1.1.0.description: FlexWave Compute v1.1.0 introduces a significantly enhanced computation pipeline tailored for high-performance signal processing tasks. This version focuses on improving execution efficiency, reducing latency, and ensuring consistent performance across complex workloads. The updated architecture optimizes multi-threaded operations, enabling better utilization of system resources and smoother parallel processing. Memory management has been refined to minimize bottlenecks during large data operations, resulting in improved responsiveness and stability. Additionally, enhanced error handling mechanisms have been introduced, allowing the system to recover gracefully from unexpected interruptions. Developers will benefit from improved debugging capabilities, more informative logs, and a more predictable runtime environment. This release is designed to support both development and production scenarios, offering a stable and scalable foundation for advanced compute operations. Overall, version 1.1.0 represents a major step forward in performance optimization, reliability, and system robustness while maintaining full compatibility with existing workflows.
patch_notes: Optimized CPU utilization for parallel tasks

1.0.0.title: Compute v1.0.0
1.0.0.description: FlexWave Compute v1.0.0 marks the initial release of the compute engine, providing a foundational framework for signal processing and data computation workflows. This version introduces the core processing pipeline, enabling basic data transformation, execution control, and task handling. Designed with simplicity in mind, it allows developers to quickly integrate compute functionality into their applications without complex configuration. While performance optimizations are limited in this release, it offers a stable and predictable environment for testing and development purposes. The architecture supports modular expansion, making it easy to build upon in future versions. Developers can utilize this version to prototype applications, validate processing logic, and establish baseline performance benchmarks. Version 1.0.0 serves as a reliable starting point for understanding the system and preparing for more advanced features introduced in subsequent updates.
